theorem.arbitrary_z_transition: P_z(0)=p0^z; for n>=1 sum_k binom(z,k)p0^(z-k)(1-p0)^k binom(n-1,k-1)(1-beta)^k beta^(n-k)
theorem.boundary_ledger: z=0 and zero rates are absorbing identities; t=0 is identity; pure birth and pure death are included; criticality uses tau
theorem.critical_yaglom: for lambda=mu>0, Z_t/(lambda*t) given survival converges to Exp(rate 1)
theorem.mixture_warning: the all-parameter family is a binomial-survivor mixture, not uniformly one negative-binomial law; special parameters can collapse the mixture
theorem.semigroup: F_t o F_u=F_(t+u); delta multiplies and tau adds
theorem.subcritical_qsd: given survival, Z_t converges to geometric success 1-lambda/mu on {1,2,...}
theorem.supercritical_limit: delta*Z_t converges; K~Binomial(z,(lambda-mu)/lambda), and conditional on K=k>=1 the limit is Gamma(k,rate (lambda-mu)/lambda)
